key.name: history-size
key.summary: Maximum number of unpinned items kept
key.description: Oldest unpinned items are dropped past this limit. Pinned items never expire.

key.name: hotkey
key.summary: Global shortcut that toggles the popup
key.description: Registered as a Cinnamon custom keybinding running "funes toggle".

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste into the focused window after selecting an item
key.description: Injects Shift+Insert (or Ctrl+V, see paste-ctrl-v-class-regex) into the window that was focused before the popup opened.

key.name: paste-ctrl-v-class-regex
key.summary: Windows matching this WM_CLASS regex are pasted with Ctrl+V
key.description: Funes injects Shift+Insert by default, which pastes in GTK, Qt, VTE terminals and browsers alike. Windows whose "res_name.res_class" matches this regex get Ctrl+V instead, e.g. 'Chromium|code'. Empty disables the override.

key.name: paste-sets-primary
key.summary: Also set the PRIMARY selection when pasting
key.description: xterm and urxvt map Shift+Insert to PRIMARY rather than CLIPBOARD; setting both makes them paste the selected item. Side effect: the current mouse selection is replaced.

key.name: popup-monitor-order
key.summary: Order of the rules deciding which monitor the popup opens on
key.description: Tried in order until one resolves: "focused" is the monitor of the window focused before the popup opened, "pointer" the monitor under the mouse, "primary" the primary monitor. Unknown entries are ignored and missing ones appended. X11 only: GTK3 cannot position windows on Wayland.

key.name: remember-size
key.summary: Persist the popup size after resizing

key.name: max-item-bytes
key.summary: Ignore clipboard text larger than this many bytes

key.name: reown-clipboard
key.summary: Take clipboard ownership after each capture
key.description: Keeps copied text available after the source application exits.

key.name: ignore-regexes
key.summary: Clipboard text matching any of these regexes is not stored

key.name: capture-images
key.description: When enabled, Funes records image data from the clipboard in addition to text.

key.name: max-image-bytes
key.summary: Ignore clipboard images larger than this many bytes (per representation)
key.description: Any single image format (PNG, JPEG, …) exceeding this limit is silently dropped. Default is 10 MiB.

key.name: image-row-height
key.summary: Height in pixels of image rows in the popup

key.name: ocr-nudge-shown
key.summary: Whether the one-time "install tesseract" notification has been shown
key.description: Set to true after the nudge notification fires so it only appears once.

key.name: ocr-enabled
key.summary: Extract text from clipboard images using Tesseract OCR
key.description: Recognized text is stored alongside image metadata and used as a hidden search corpus. Requires the tesseract binary. Privacy: OCR output is stored in plain text inside history.db.
